name: stay-awhile
description: Ambient music, living landscapes, and gentle cues to help you stay with one task while Claude works.

track.title: Working sound
track.description: Loop that plays while Claude is working.

volume.title: Volume
volume.description: 0.0 (silent) to 1.0 (full). Applies where the audio player supports it.

cues.title: Event cues
cues.description: Play short sounds when a turn finishes, fails, or needs your input.

eye_cue_every.title: Look-away cue interval
eye_cue_every.description: Nudge you to look at something far away every Nth wait. 0 disables it.
